segments.text: Verifying agent's work is unbelievably
important, and I've started putting more
emphasis on this with my agents. For
instance, I'm using a custom video
editor to record this right now, and I
wanted to drop my dependency on OBS. And
so, I needed to build a replacement OBS.
Now, of course, it didn't need to have
all the features of OBS, it just had the
features that I needed, but I wanted it
to have exactly the same performance.
And so, what I did, I got the agent to
build a recorder scorecard, which would
score OBS on a bunch of metrics and
score us based on how well it performs
against it. This script takes about 20
minutes to run, and it gives me all
sorts of metrics. And the way I'm going
to get this working is the agent is
going to, once a day, try to rerun this
and get the results better and better,
looking for improvements every single
time. Now, it's got a very clear set of
metrics that it needs to track over
time, it can just look for more and more
creative ways to try to make those
metrics better. This is a massively
underused way of using agents. You just
give it a goal, and over time it will
get closer to that goal. This is a
